hypothesis: Under either F76 source arrival order, at most two native legal lossless memory interventions may rescue some cases not rescued by one action, but a bounded oracle cannot establish global impossibility when its search cap is reached.

frozen_source.baseline: F60 exactly unchanged per prefix, no refit

protocol.one_step: All 72 event indices ascending and all unique native legal alternative states excluding F60 baseline; independent 72-prefix causality witness of any rescue.
protocol.two_step: For F60 failed and one-step unresolved cases only; first intervention indices 0,4,8,...,60; second intervention indices exactly i+1,i+4,i+8,i+12 when <=71, ascending; each alternative comes from ACTION.actions on actual memory; frozen F60 between and after.
protocol.causal_confirmation: Independent public 72-prefix auditor must verify every claimed one/two-step rescue.
protocol.report_censored_correctly: If maximum pairs exhausted, mark CENSORED, not proven infeasible. If exhausted all prereg bounded candidates without rescue, say NOT_FOUND_IN_BOUNDED_SEARCH, not impossible.
protocol.offline_teacher_status: Unfair future-answer oracle, NONCOMPETITIVE, not a trained or deployed policy.
